objective: Persist distinct billing and selected ship-to VAT and verify actual freight integration maps both correctly.

sources.description: Original 27-step source with full sample JSON
Focused original OpenAPI extraction plus current application-bindings.json and read-discovery.json

source_steps.text: Installation of QuickShip and setup for Kinetic Integration is needed to run this test case. See attached installation guide

Ship Codes setup in QuickShip
On your server, open QuickShip app
Select Authentication Type = QuickShip Native
Select Registration code = quickshipdemo
username = admin
password = [redacted; use external credentials]
Login

Open Kinetic App
Login with [external credentials]
Move to Company = EPIC06 and Workstation = Freight Service 400

Active IN UOM Class
Go to UOM Class
Production Management/Engineering/Setup/UOM Class
 
Enter Class = Length
In the UOM List grid, click on IN record
Active = True
Save
Exit UOM Class Maintenance

QuickShip settings for Workstation
Go to Workstation Maintenance
Material Management/Shipping / Receiving/Setup/Workstation

Select the workstation you are working on (PACK)
Weight Input = Prompt for Weight
Manifest Enabled = True
Web Service URL = http://quickshipweb/EpicorFreightService.svc?regCode=QuickShipDemo
Manifest/Weight Capture Point = Both
Size UOM = IN
Make sure weight UOM = LB
Log manifest messages = True
Save

Setup QuickShip integration for Kinetic Company
Go to Company configuration 
System Setup/Company/Site Maintenance/Company Configuration
Click on Modules button
 In left navigation menu at the left, go to Materials tab
Expand the Shipping receiving Card
From the Freight Service Integration combo, select REST API Integration
On the Quickship API URL enter = http://quickshipweb/
-Registration code = quickshipdemo
-username = admin
-password = password123
-Save and exit

Create Purchased part
 Go to Part
Main menu > Material Management>Inventory Management>Setup>Part
On the landing page, click the <Plus> icon to create a new Part
 Set Part& Description = EP1
Make sure Type = Purchased
On the left navigation menu go to Part tab
Scroll down and set Sales Unit Price = 1.00
Save

In the navigation menu at the left, go to Integrations tab
Enter Schedule B Code = 2222.22
Save

Adjust Quantity for parts
Go to Quantity Adjustment
Material Management/Inventory Management/General Operations/Quantity Adjustment
Enter Part = EP1
Enter Bin = 00-00-00
Enter Adjust Quantity = 200
Select Reason = Add new Part 
Click Adjust button

Verify the VAT number in customer master and ship to details in customer screen
Go to Customer

Search for the customer ECD
Navigate to Billing 
Verify the field and enter the VAT ID and save
Navigate to Ship to Detail
Verify the field and enter the VAT ID and save

expectations.text: VAT ID should be displayed in billing and ship to details

source_steps.text:
Create an order for stock parts
Go to Order entry
Sales Management/Customer Relationship Management/General Operations/Order Entry

Click the plus icon to add a new sales order
Enter customer ECD which has VAT number in master and ship to details and tab out
Select Need By date = Today's date
Save

In the navigation menu at the left, Move to Lines > Detail tab
Click the Plus icon to add a new line
Enter Part = EP1 and tab out
Enter order quantity = 100.00
Save
Go to the overflow menu and click Reserve / Allocate

Select the 1 line displayed corresponding to your SO Lines
Then in overflow menu click allocate by part

expectations.text: Allocation Process criteria screen opens up

source_steps.text: Click Continue

expectations.text: Ad Hoc Allocation Template Screen is displayed

source_steps.text:
Set Release to Picking = True
Then click Continue

expectations.text:
Message displayed: 

1 Demand record(s) allocated.
0 Demand record(s) cross docked.
1 Demand record(s) selected for picking.
1 Demand record(s) submitted for picking.

source_steps.text: Click Ok

expectations.text:
Message displayed: "Release for Picking
Do you want to print the released items?"

source_steps.text:
Click No
Exit Fulfillment Workbench screen

Pick order Lines to Shipping Area
Go to Material Request Queue
Material Management/Advanced Material Management/General Operations/Material Request Queue
Filter transactions from today's date 
Select the record displayed related to part EP1 and click Select button
Move to My Selections tab
Click process

expectations.text:
WIP/Material Movement Transaction slide panel is displayed
Make sure Part = EP1

source_steps.text:
Scroll down and make sure To Warehouse = Shipping Area and To Bin = SHP-1
Then Click OK

expectations.text: Record for part EP1 should disappear from the grid

source_steps.text:
Create a new CS Pack
Go to Customer Shipment
Material Management/Shipping / Receiving/General Operations/Customer Shipment Entry

Click the Plus icon Create a new Pack
Enter Order number (####) previously generated
Select Ship Via = FedEx Ground
Set Ship date = Today's date
Enter Package Code = BOX
Save

In the left navigation menu, go to Shipment Lines / Line Details tab
Click the Plus icon to add a New Line
Enter Line = 1 and Release = 1
On the From Inventory card, select Warehouse = Shipping Area and Bin = SHP-1
Make sure Our Ship Qty = 100
Make sure customer part is fetched from Order 
Save

In the left navigation menu, go back to Details tab
Enter weight = 3.0000 LB
Save
Click Close button

expectations.text: Pack status should change to CLOSED

source_steps.text: Then, click Freight button

expectations.text:
Status should change to Freighted
Tracking number field should be populated

source_steps.text:
Check pack on QuickShip > Shipments
Open Quick ship app 
In the QuickShip homepage, click on Shipments
Click search button and filter shipments from yesterday date to tomorrow's date.
Click on search

expectations.text: A record for your Customer shipment should be displayed

source_steps.text:
Check API request for pack shipment
In your server, go to your local QuickShip installation folder (i.e. C:\inetpub\wwwroot\QuickShip)
Click on your CarrierXMLFile folder 
There, open the shipment request JSON file with the last creation date and time

expectations.text: If Customer has VAT ID in billing and shipto details, it should send to Quickship through API request json file Actual parentCustomer.vat=BillingVAT and shipTo.vat=SHIPTOVAT; original sample JSON retained in source-prose.txt.
